name: persona-intermediate-landscape-songs-list
note: Landscape audit (2026-10-05) Direction A, Songs list. An intermediate player props the phone sideways on a stand with a backing track playing and wants to pick the next song. Before the rail the 69px header + 67px tab bar + a 68px two-row bar + a 104px .view reservation left #libSongs at 0px on a 340px-tall screen: no row was tappable and no scroll could fix it. Asserts at 915x340, 844x340 and 740x320 with the bar up (video parked) in Jams, All and Setlist: the list band above the bar is >=180px (three rows), the scroller ends above the bar, the view switcher and its row controls (Search & filter + Add, or Clear + Start) share one row, and the first two rows' body + lead hit-test to themselves at >=44px. Then 412x800 portrait keeps the stacked chrome, bottom tab bar and two-row bar (structural no-regression; box-level identity is diffed out of band).

steps.selector: [data-npkey='reggae backing track in a major|petti music studios|A|major']
[data-npkey='reggae backing track in a major|petti music studios|A|major'] .li-body

steps.label: fixture: plain mini bar up (video parked by the persona's remembered choice), no theater scrim, no PIP
915x340 Jams, bar up: the list keeps >=180px (three rows) above the one-row bar, segment + Search & filter share one row, and the first two rows (body + lead) hit-test to themselves at >=44px
